'''Bleeker''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]]. In that year, they worked in the [[Tech (Imperial Intelligence)|Tech Section]] of Intelligence under the [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Royd Pew]], who had them test experimental [[Parawings/Legends|parawings]] being developed by Tech. They performed one test while Pew and Intelligence [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Jahan Cross]] observed, which failed due to Bleeker crashing almost instantly to the ground. Despite Bleeker's display, Cross took a pair of the parawings, claiming that Bleeker failed due to the fact that they lacked experience at [[pit racing]]. Bleeker had fair skin and [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and wore a skintight black suit while testing the parawings.<ref name="AotE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bleeker appeared in the [[Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse 1|first issue]] of the [[Star Wars comic books|comic-book]] miniseries ''[[Star Wars: Agent of the Empire]]''. The comic was written by [[John Ostrander]], illustrated by [[Stéphane Roux]], and released by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="AotE" /> on [[December 14]], [[2011]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54010/star_wars_agent_of_the_empire_-_iron_eclipse_2011_1|text=Star Wars: Agent of the Empire - Iron Eclipse (2011) #1}}</ref>
